title: Totem Wand of Undying
description: Adds a simple wand design in place of the usual totem of undying. For whimsical people.
body:
Hello, I've taken something from a previous pack and separated it into it's own. It changes the Totem of Undying into a wand for all the whimsical people out there, like me.

I do not have any plans to change this or add to it in the future aside from updating compatibility.

![Totem wand, pink, yellow, purple.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9362ce1f4ae1ee43aabfa9aeb06a1e46cb1b1591.png)

_**Do not repost or re-distribute this elsewhere. Only link directly to this modrinth page if sharing.**_
